title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Buyout, Withdrawal and Default Terms by Programme
content:
Where a member will not deliver bushels they have sold, the terms on which the contract may be closed out, and what is charged where the window simply closes, are programme terms of Grain Marketing Contracts.

| Programme | Flat administrative fee on a buyout (USD) | Loss multiplier on undelivered bushels | Notice due before the window closes (calendar days) | An application may be withdrawn before countersigning | Default penalty on undelivered bushels (USD per bushel) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | 0.00 | 0.0 | 0 | Yes | 0.00 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | 75.00 | 1.0 | 5 | Yes | 0.15 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | 125.00 | 1.0 | 5 | Yes | 0.15 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | 150.00 | 1.0 | 7 | Yes | 0.20 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | 60.00 | 0.5 | 3 | Yes | 0.10 |
| Minimum Price Contract | 200.00 | 1.0 | 7 | No | 0.25 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | 400.00 | 2.0 | 10 | No | 0.30 |

## The columns read as terms

The administrative fee is a flat charge the programme carries on a buyout. The loss multiplier is the multiple the programme applies to the loss on undelivered bushels. The notice column is the calendar days before the close of the delivery window by which buyout notice is due. The withdrawal column says whether an application still in applied standing may be withdrawn at no cost; the Minimum Price Contract and the Managed Accumulator Program are the two programmes that do not open that door. The default penalty is what undelivered bushels carry per bushel where the window closes with no buyout arranged.

## Illustration on hypothetical bushels

Take a hypothetical Managed Accumulator Program with 5,000 bushels undelivered. That programme carries the heaviest terms in the catalogue: a flat administrative fee of 400.00, a loss multiplier of 2.0, ten calendar days of notice and a default penalty of 0.30 per bushel, which on those hypothetical 5,000 bushels is fifteen hundred dollars of penalty. The lightest terms belong to the Delayed Price Agreement, at 60.00, a multiplier of 0.5, three days of notice and 0.10 per bushel.
